trigger: Account URLs were listed as a catalog. The current step needed one click.
change: Show only the account URL the current step needs. One markdown link, full https.
why: A list of dashboards mixed the next action with unused links.
kept: The URLs themselves stayed in a lookup table, not pasted as a list.

trigger: The one-link line was too clipped.
change: The chat line must be full Japanese with 熟語, not a fragment.
why: 終わったら削除します was later rejected as too short. The length of the approved sentence became the lock.
kept: One link per step.

trigger: The user approved the three-line account-link length.
change: Lock the three-line form: need, one link plus 貼付, then 漏洩防止 and delete.
why: That length was judged ちょうどいい.
kept: One URL. 熟語.

trigger: Post-success remaining work was more than one action.
change: List remaining work as bullets of the same locked 語数.
why: A packed paragraph was hard to scan. Parallel leftover steps needed the same length, not a new voice.
kept: The three-line form when there is one remaining action.

trigger: The post-success step was split into labeled fields 手段 目標 条件 理由 措置.
change: That split was registered as a failure. It did not become the form.
why: The user said it was 読みにくくなった and asked to return to the original sentence form.
kept: Bullets only for parallel leftover items, never as labels on one sentence.

trigger: After the labeled-field failure.
change: Restore the post-success step to one readable sentence of the locked 語数.
why: The original sentence form was ちょうどいい and then 定着.
kept: Same-length bullets when there are two leftover actions.

trigger: The token-delete line was shortened to 終わったら削除します.
change: Shortening was a failure. The locked 語数 returned.
why: The short line dropped 熟語 and the reason 漏洩防止.
kept: Delete-after-use as a full sentence.

trigger: The locked form needed an English Feature name plus v1.0.
change: Announce the form as 操作案内 1.0, then it became a registered Feature.
why: Named Features compose. An unnamed chat habit would not survive dispatch.
kept: The locked three-line and two-bullet Japanese.

trigger: Feature names are English.
change: Rename 操作案内 to Action Guide v1.0. Spec stays account-links.mdc.
why: The lock was the form, not the Japanese title of the Feature.
kept: Locked 語数. One URL. Token paste one line. Revoke after.

trigger: Action Guide was drawn on turns that were not a click or a token.
change: when narrowed to click, mint, paste, revoke. Contradiction C0002.
why: Always-on token nag mixed with kernel talk and raised cost.
kept: The locked form itself, only when the situation matches.

trigger: Named behaviors needed a place to live.
change: Feature Registry v1.0. English name plus v1.0. Features compose Studio Framework.
why: A locked chat form without a registry would be a one-off habit.
kept: Action Guide as the first registered Feature.

trigger: Registered Features were coming out every turn.
change: Draw a Feature only when its situation matches. alwaysApply false on specs except the dispatcher.
why: Eager draw mixed Action Guide into unrelated turns.
kept: English names. Register on 定着.

trigger: A reusable form appeared and needed an autonomous ask.
change: Locked Registry intro. Draw-and-use voice. Settle Prompt born beside it.
why: The user should not have to say 定着 every time. The registry should ask, unless already ordered.
kept: Draw on when.

trigger: User-facing Japanese needed a mark Feature.
change: Registry draws Voice Mark when writing Japanese.
why: Marks sit on locked lines. They are a unit, not ad-hoc bold.
kept: Locked Registry intro.

trigger: A packed Feature paragraph was hard to scan.
change: Voice Mark may structure parallel items as bullets of the locked 語数. Registry lists by group when many.
why: One paragraph of many Features failed scanning. Labels 手段 目標 were already rejected.
kept: One locked sentence is not split into labeled fields.

trigger: Opening every spec was expensive.
change: Look up layers in map.json before opening specs. Feature Registry v1.5 dispatches through Unit Map.
why: Progressive disclosure. Eager load grows with the library.
kept: when-match draw.

trigger: The protocol needed a portable kernel, a ledger, and a purpose pack.
change: Dispatch also opens Unit Kernel, Field Ledger, Purpose Pack on their when.
why: Map → Draw was not enough to transplant. Evidence and purpose had to be files.
kept: One routing level. map.json first.

trigger: Known conflicts were unmapped.
change: After match, apply contradictions and forbids. Keep prefer, drop the other spec.
why: A known conflict not in map.json is an unmapped failure.
kept: Related is compose. Contradiction is exclude.

trigger: The user asked to map how minimal units grow, and to record that process in a dedicated Feature.
change: Dispatch also reads growth/index.json. On born bump lock reject split settle store, append through Growth Map.
why: Field Ledger records events. It does not map lineage. Growth needed its own index and log.
kept: map.json first. Ledger for fact experiment success failure insight.

trigger: A reusable unregistered form was praised.
change: Settle Prompt v1.0. Ask 定着させるか autonomously. Skip if 定着 登録 固定 was already ordered. Contradiction C0001.
why: Waiting for the user to say 定着 dropped the lock.
kept: The ask form is locked. Do not restyle.

trigger: User-facing Japanese needed emphasis and notes.
change: Voice Mark v1.0. Bold for carrying words. 括弧 for a gloss or a limit.
why: The locked Action Guide needed marks that sit on top without rewriting 語数.
kept: Locked sentence shape.

trigger: One paragraph of many Features was hard to scan.
change: Bullets for two or more parallel items. Each bullet stays the locked 語数. Group by layer when listing many.
why: Structure helps scanning. The rejected labeled split does not.
kept: No 手段 目標 条件 理由 措置.

trigger: Markdown bold was hard to see.
change: Stop bold. Underline carrying words. More 「」 and （）. Forbid F0001.
why: The user said bold was 見えにくい.
kept: Bullets for parallel items. Locked lines unchanged.

trigger: Hierarchy plus a cheap JSON index was requested. Specs were expensive to open eagerly.
change: Unit Map v1.0. layers, units, related in map.json. Match layer when, then unit when, then open spec.
why: Progressive disclosure. One routing level.
kept: Feature Registry as dispatcher.

trigger: Map contradictions.
change: contradictions and forbids in map.json. Prefer one unit, drop the other spec. Copy contradiction line when listing.
why: Unmapped conflict is a failure of the map.
kept: One layer level. No extra nesting under Layer. C0005.

trigger: The operating protocol had to move to another system this person uses.
change: Unit Kernel v1.0. KERNEL.md, PORT.md. General kernel, cascading purpose, portable ledger rows.
why: Files outlive tools. Purpose is swapped. Kernel is not rewritten per project.
kept: Map → Draw. One layer.

trigger: Architecture decisions needed fact, interpretation, and decision kept apart.
change: Field Ledger v1.0. Append-only jsonl. Kinds: fact experiment success failure insight. Index first, open matching lines only.
why: Do not rewrite an accepted row. Do not dump the log into the Feature catalog. C0006.
kept: portable true|false.

trigger: This instance is Entheria Studio, not a generic kernel demo.
change: Purpose Pack v1.0. purpose.json: public #01, /update to D1 and R2, Action Guide for Cloudflare.
why: Specialization lives in the pack. On port, replace this file.
kept: Kernel units unchanged.

trigger: この構成で定着, plus hierarchical text.
change: Studio Framework v1.8 settled. HIERARCHY.txt is the constitution in hierarchical text. Eight units.
why: The user ordered settle of the mapped shape.
kept: Kernel, map, ledger, purpose, protocol, mark as one layer each.

trigger: 機能の説明, then a request for lowest-load Japanese from cognitive science.
change: FEATURES.txt explained units. Load was still sitting only in Voice Mark. The next step split load into its own Feature.
why: Voice Mark is marks. Ease is sourced load rules. Two concerns.
kept: Voice Mark v1.2 marks.

trigger: Implement lowest-load immediately graspable Japanese from peer-reviewed cognitive science.
change: Read Ease v1.0. Studio Framework v1.9. Draw with Voice Mark on user-facing Japanese.
why: Marks without load rules still packed turns.
kept: Locked Action Guide and Registry intro are not shortened.

trigger: Integrate the sourced rules into Read Ease.
change: Read Ease v1.1. Studio Framework v1.10. CLT, Mayer, JMET 25(4), Tokimoto, Cowan. Sources file. Locked lines exempt. 熟語 stay with a gloss.
why: v1.0 named the aim. v1.1 pinned the papers and the exceptions.
kept: ですます. One topic per new sentence. 3–4 bullets.

trigger: Asked whether the sources were Japanese cognitive-science literature. Most were English general CS. User said とりあえず、これで十分だ.
change: Keep Read Ease v1.1 and the source mix. Do not add more sources in that pass.
why: Honesty about the mix was accepted as enough.
kept: JMET and Tokimoto as the Japanese-sentence subset.

trigger: Studio Framework v1.8 をダウンロードできるようにして.
change: public zip plus Worker attachment route. Tag studio-framework-v1.8.
why: A snapshot was requested. The first store was a site file.
kept: Source still in .cursor/. Tag on 685734f.

trigger: 間違えた。Githubにフレームワークとして入れておきたい。
change: Remove the public zip and save page. README points at .cursor/framework. Git is the store. GitHub via Create repo.
why: A Worker zip is not a framework. Lineage belongs in git.
kept: Tag studio-framework-v1.8. Current instance v1.11.

trigger: あとこれらの最小単位の機能が少しずつどうやって成長していくか、マッピングしてください。その過程を詳細に記録する。それ専用の機能を作って。
change: Growth Map v1.0. GROWTH.txt map, growth/index.json lookup, growth/log.jsonl process. Studio Framework v1.11. Feature Registry v1.8 opens this index.
why: Field Ledger cannot map lineage. A dedicated unit keeps the catalog cheap and the process append-only.
kept: Ledger kinds unchanged. One layer. No extra nesting.

trigger: studio よりも汎用的な名称にして。Entheria Studioも関係ないので入れないで。
change: GitHub repository name is unit-kernel. Description names Unit Kernel only. No Studio, no Entheria.
why: Studio Framework is one instance. The portable kernel is Unit Kernel.
kept: Internal instance name Studio Framework. Purpose Pack still names this field.
